missingForCompleteClaimValuation: The date-matched economic value of outstanding Avride subsidiary options/RSUs or enough subsidiary equity/capitalization information to allocate the parent enterprise value to those instruments. The filings disclose counts, strikes and grant accounting but not a current aggregate claim value; unamortized compensation expense is not that value.

A specified mutually exclusive treatment of convertible claims: filing fair value as a debt claim, or a contractual conversion model. Counting both convertible debt and converted shares would double count.
A specified parent-option treatment. Counts and exercise-price data exist, enabling a transparent full-exercise scenario, but that scenario is not an option time-value appraisal.
otherLimitations: The current generic loss-to-margin operating case may yield a nonpositive operating value; that is a model-suitability problem, separate from missing filing dates.
